_notes_fabrication: Parts economy on a surface (docs/parts-contract.md; game/sim/Surface/Fabrication.cs). recipes: what a Machine Shop (a building with a fabricator) makes, one order at a time per fabricator line: id = the item it makes (one per order, a resource of tier part / spare / construction), in = what one order takes (taken from stock when the order starts, not when it is queued; an order whose inputs are short is skipped and stays queued), seconds = how long it takes at full speed (x power share x condition x the building's speed bonuses; x fabricator.speed); era_min / era_max for later. The output goes into storage (an order waits when there is no room). The design doc's recipes use plasma conduits, isolinear chips and transparent aluminum; nothing makes those on the surface yet, so these use duranium, tritanium and parasteel only. hub: a finished colony core's small workshop makes only these recipes (the four spare kits), straight from materials (the recipe tree flattened: a kit's parts replaced by their inputs), one at a time, taking time_factor x the summed shop seconds of the whole tree; speed 0.5 is the same thing said the other way round (the hub works at half a shop's speed, so it is not applied a second time). kit_points: one kit per this many condition (buildings) or integrity (vehicles) points repaired, rounded up. kits: which spare kit each building (buildings) and vehicle (units) uses for repairs; default = every other building that wears. breakdown_kits: extra kits a broken-down crawler's repair takes, by breakdown severity id. pad_tyre_kit / pad_tyre_kits: a repair pad fits each flat tyre and restocks each missing spare tyre for this many of this kit (the rovers' own kit). A repair takes all its kits when the crew (or the drones) start work; with too few in stock it waits, and the missing kits are queued at the front of a fabricator as auto orders. jury_rig: a repair without kits (JuryRigCommand / JuryRigUnitsCommand): only up to max_condition, speed x the normal repair speed, and until a proper repair the building wears wear_multiplier x faster (a rover wears that much faster too) and a crawler breaks down breakdown_multiplier x as often (a rover's hazards and flats too). default_target: the keep-in-stock target every player starts with for each kit one of their finished buildings or vehicles uses (other items start at 0); below target (stock + queued) an auto order goes to one of their Machine Shops (with the parts it is short of queued in front of it), else, for kits, to a colony core's workshop. All numbers are placeholders.
